item.title: Pakistani general says Iran diplomacy still 'alive, despite US blockade, failed talks
item.summary: The U.S. naval blockade on Iran may be leverage to resume diplomacy, says retired Pakistani general, as both sides were reportedly close to a deal.

item.title: Hillary Clinton warns US in 'very weak position' with Iran, 'lost the leverage' in negotiations
item.summary: Hillary Clinton said Monday during an MS NOW interview that the U.S. is in a "weak position" on Iran negotiations, urging the administration to bring in new negotiators.

item.title: Obama CIA chief under DOJ scrutiny pushes fringe Trump ouster plan
item.summary: Ex-CIA Director John Brennan calls for Trump's removal via the 25th Amendment, citing concerns over his Truth Social threats toward Iran as unlawful.

item.title: Trump warns China of ‘big problems’ over Iran weapons as Xi summit nears
item.summary: President Trump warns China of "big problems" if it supplies air defense systems to Iran amid reports of potential MANPADS transfers to Tehran.

item.title: Fleetwood Mac's Lindsey Buckingham's alleged stalker arrested after attack on guitarist
item.summary: Lindsey Buckingham's alleged stalker Michelle Dick was arrested in Indiana and faces stalking, assault and threat charges tied to incidents since 2021.

item.title: Soros-backed prosecutor set for Capitol Hill grilling as sanctuary policies face reckoning
item.summary: Steve Descano agrees to testify before Congress as House Republicans probe Fairfax County sanctuary policies following a murder linked to immigration.

item.title: Florida teacher accused of sex with student whose parents tracked his location
item.summary: Florida math teacher Kirsten Rose faces five counts of unlawful sexual activity with a minor after authorities say the student's parents tracked their son's location.

item.title: Swalwell faces House ethics probe over alleged sexual misconduct as expulsion threat looms
item.summary: The House Ethics Committee announced an investigation into Rep. Eric Swalwell following allegations of sexual misconduct.

item.title: Utah Valley University faces backlash over commencement speaker choice after Charlie Kirk's assassination
item.summary: Utah Valley University faces backlash over commencement speaker Sharon McMahon's past comments about Charlie Kirk following his assassination on campus.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler takes issue with Masters' course conditions after second-place finish
item.summary: Scottie Scheffler took issue with Augusta National course conditions after finishing one stroke behind back-to-back Masters winner Rory McIlroy Sunday.
